en: A black‑and‑white winter scene of a ski resort in the mountains. In the foreground, skiers move across snow-covered slopes with many ski tracks and scattered small fir trees. A chairlift runs diagonally from the lower right toward the upper left, with several chairs carrying people uphill. In the mid‑distance there are a few small chalet-style buildings near the base of steeper slopes, and behind them rises a craggy, rocky peak. The sky is clear and bright, with no visible clouds. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
